list.name: project
list.label: Проект
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN '(не задан)' ELSE '[Jenkins] ' || project END AS __text, CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END AS __value FROM testbridge_analytics.runs ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN '(не задан)' ELSE '[Jenkins] ' || project END AS __text, CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END AS __value FROM testbridge_analytics.runs ORDER BY 1

list.name: suite
list.label: Набор
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.suite IS NULL THEN '(не задан)' ELSE '[Набор] ' || s.suite END AS __text, CASE WHEN s.suite IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || s.suite END AS __value FROM testbridge_analytics.tests t LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest(t.suites) AS s(suite) ON TRUE WHERE (CASE WHEN t.project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || t.project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.suite IS NULL THEN '(не задан)' ELSE '[Набор] ' || s.suite END AS __text, CASE WHEN s.suite IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || s.suite END AS __value FROM testbridge_analytics.tests t LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest(t.suites) AS s(suite) ON TRUE WHERE (CASE WHEN t.project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || t.project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Сводка прогонов

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN '(не задан)' ELSE '[Jenkins] ' || project END AS "Проект", build_number AS "Сборка", build_url AS "Ссылка на сборку", imported_at AS "Получен", run_status AS "Результат тестов", import_status AS "Импорт", final_count AS "Тесты", attempt_count AS "Попытки" FROM testbridge_analytics.runs WHERE $__timeFilter(imported_at) AND (CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) ORDER BY imported_at DESC

panels.description: Время — приём архива. Импорт и результат тестов — разные статусы.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'passed') AS "passed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS "failed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'broken') AS "broken", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'skipped') AS "skipped", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'unknown') AS "unknown" FROM testbridge_analytics.tests WHERE $__timeFilter(imported_at) AND (CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) AND ((cardinality(suites) = 0 AND 'n:' IN (${suite:sqlstring})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(suites) AS selected_suite WHERE ('v:' || selected_suite) IN (${suite:sqlstring}))) AND is_final

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'passed')::double precision / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS value FROM testbridge_analytics.tests WHERE $__timeFilter(imported_at) AND (CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) AND ((cardinality(suites) = 0 AND 'n:' IN (${suite:sqlstring})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(suites) AS selected_suite WHERE ('v:' || selected_suite) IN (${suite:sqlstring}))) AND is_final

panels.title: Медленные тесты — топ-10

targets.rawSql: WITH per_run AS (SELECT import_id, project, name, imported_at AS time, max(duration_seconds) AS value FROM testbridge_analytics.tests WHERE $__timeFilter(imported_at) AND (CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) AND ((cardinality(suites) = 0 AND 'n:' IN (${suite:sqlstring})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(suites) AS selected_suite WHERE ('v:' || selected_suite) IN (${suite:sqlstring}))) AND is_final AND duration_seconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY import_id, project, name, imported_at), top_tests AS (SELECT project, name, max(value) AS max_seconds FROM per_run GROUP BY project, name ORDER BY max_seconds DESC, project NULLS LAST, name LIMIT 10) SELECT p.time, p.value, CASE WHEN p.project IS NULL THEN '(не задан)' ELSE '[Jenkins] ' || p.project END || ' · ' || p.name AS metric FROM per_run p JOIN top_tests t ON p.project IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.project AND p.name = t.name ORDER BY p.time, metric, p.import_id

panels.description: Максимальная длительность тестов с одним названием внутри каждого импорта; топ по максимуму за выбранный период. Легенда: проект и название.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(imported_at, '$__interval'), percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) AS "P50", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) AS "P95", max(duration_seconds) AS "Максимум" FROM testbridge_analytics.tests WHERE $__timeFilter(imported_at) AND (CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) AND ((cardinality(suites) = 0 AND 'n:' IN (${suite:sqlstring})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(suites) AS selected_suite WHERE ('v:' || selected_suite) IN (${suite:sqlstring}))) AND is_final AND duration_seconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Самые долгие прогоны

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN '(не задан)' ELSE '[Jenkins] ' || project END AS "Проект", build_number AS "Сборка", build_url AS "Ссылка на сборку", imported_at AS "Получен", run_status AS "Результат", duration_seconds AS "Окно тестов, с" FROM testbridge_analytics.runs WHERE $__timeFilter(imported_at) AND (CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN 'n:' ELSE 'v:' || project END) IN (${project:sqlstring}) AND duration_seconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY duration_seconds DESC, imported_at DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Окно тестов от первого корректного начала до последнего корректного окончания; не длительность задания Jenkins.
